description: This Java class implements a shipping quote module for UPS integration, including configuration validation, XML request generation, HTTP communication, response parsing, and handling shipping options. It interacts with external libraries like Apache HttpClient, Apache Digester, and SLF4J, and makes use of project-specific models such as PackageDetails, Delivery, MerchantStore, and ShippingOption.

classes.name: UPSParsedElements
classes.description: Helper class to parse, store, and access UPS API response elements including status, error, and shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided UPS integration configuration, checking for required keys and options, throwing exception if validation fails.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Builds and sends an XML request to UPS API to retrieve shipping options based on packages and delivery info, parses response, and returns list of options.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Returns custom configuration if any; returns null indicating no custom configuration implementation.
